name: Brief Resilience Scale (BRS)
construct: Resilience / ability to bounce back from stress
response_model: 6 items; 1–5 agreement; reverse items 2, 4, 6; final score = mean of six scored items (1–5)
rights: University of Salford PsyTech resource reports no copyright restrictions for the BRS. Exact implementation uses the standard 6-item form and 5-point response scale documented in open-access psychometric literature.

items.text: I tend to bounce back quickly after hard times
I have a hard time making it through stressful events
It does not take me long to recover from a stressful event
It is hard for me to snap back when something bad happens
I usually come through difficult times with little trouble
I tend to take a long time to get over set-backs in my life
